art_direction: 雾长春花蓝底，蜜赭虹膜侧带，宽笔上缘下安静左望。
composition_variation: Keep the left eye low and shallow, with its outer tip descending gently. Set the right eye ten percent higher and broader. Shift both pupils slightly left. Press each black upper brush shape firmly near its inner third, tapering outward. Preserve matching #C7A25C iris side bands and one long narrow ivory glint inside each large flat black pupil. Keep inner bands slightly slimmer. Use a clearly visible but gentle pale periwinkle paper background, matching the exact palette below. Do not wash it out to white. Keep it flat and quiet with no gradients or decorative marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
